title: Hybrid Approach for Enhancing Lesion Segmentation in Fundus Images
abstract: arXiv:2509.25549v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Choroidal nevi are common benign pigmented lesions in the eye, with a small risk of transforming into melanoma. Early detection is critical to improving survival rates, but misdiagnosis or delayed diagnosis can lead to poor outcomes. Despite advancements in AI-based image analysis, diagnosing choroidal nevi in colour fundus images remains challenging, particularly for clinicians without specialized expertise. Existing datasets often suffer from low resolution and inconsistent labelling, limiting the effectiveness of segmentation models. This paper addresses the challenge of achieving precise segmentation of fundus lesions, a critical step toward developing robust diagnostic tools. While deep learning models like U-Net have demonstrated effectiveness, their accuracy heavily depends on the quality and quantity of annotated data. Previous mathematical/clustering segmentation methods, though accurate, required extensive human input

translated_title: 一种用于增强眼底图像病灶分割的混合方法
translated_abstract: 脉络膜痣是眼部常见的良性色素性病变，有较小的风险转化为黑色素瘤。早期检测对于提高生存率至关重要，而误诊或延迟诊断可能导致不良后果。尽管基于AI的图像分析技术不断进步，但在彩色眼底图像中诊断脉络膜痣仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于缺乏专业知识的临床医生而言。现有数据集通常存在分辨率低和标注不一致的问题，限制了分割模型的有效性。本文旨在解决眼底病变精确分割这一挑战，这是开发稳健诊断工具的关键步骤。虽然像U-Net这样的深度学习模型已展现出有效性，但其准确性在很大程度上依赖于标注数据的质量和数量。以往的数学/聚类分割方法虽然准确，但需要大量的人工输入。
tldr: 本文提出一种混合方法，将深度学习模型与传统数学/聚类分割方法相结合，以克服眼底图像数据集分辨率低、标注不一致以及标注数据不足的问题，实现脉络膜痣等眼底病变的精确分割，助力早期诊断工具的开发。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hybrid approach that combines deep learning models with traditional mathematical/clustering segmentation methods to overcome challenges of low-resolution, inconsistently labeled data, achieving precise segmentation of fundus lesions such as choroidal nevi to support early diagnosis.
